text_block_list.text:
After finishing the NHK Mile Cup, Taiki 
Shuttle openly expressed her joy at 
bringing happiness to so many people.

Her next target... the Mile Championship, 
where the finest veterans gather!

To gain the experience needed for her 
goal, they decided to enter the Unicorn 
Stakes, the perfect race for it.

Aiming to take on dirt races with her 
sights set on the grand stage, Taiki 
Shuttle dashed full speed ahead!
